observed_discontinuity: After a major DEX GC, the next original DEX iget-object in loadImage dereferenced an invalid launched Activity object and the Simulator process exited with EXC_BAD_ACCESS.

call_path: instance fields remain valid after GC

required_semantics: A launched Activity remains strongly reachable for its active lifecycle.
A host native pointer is not a Dalvik GC root.
Original DEX may access Activity fields after any major GC while the Activity is active.

call_path: host game state retains a native pointer
major GC omits the Activity from the root set
loadImage executes iget-object on collected storage

differences.description: AGR retained the launched Activity only through a host pointer instead of the VM process root traversed by GC.
differences.relevance: This permits collection before the next original DEX field access and directly explains the observed EXC_BAD_ACCESS.

first_relevant_difference: The Activity is absent from DxVM.activity_instance when the major GC root set is marked.
host_adaptation: Store the active Activity in the existing host-side VM lifecycle root; do not add a game-specific retention path.
validation: bounded Simulator run remained alive beyond the former crash
original DEX resumed loadImage after major GC
